ministry.title: Ministry / source
ministry.description: Which ministry's tender publication to scrape. 'all' (default) runs both. 'finance' = Ministry of Finance procurement notices (finance.gov.bw). 'health' = Ministry of Health & Wellness tenders (moh.gov.bw).

maxResultsPerMinistry.title: Max results per ministry
maxResultsPerMinistry.description: Maximum number of tender records to return per ministry. Both sources currently carry fewer than 10 records total, so this is mostly a safety cap for future growth.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Neither ministry site has any anti-bot gate, so a plain datacenter proxy (or no proxy) also works -- residential is offered for consistency with other actors in this collection.
